listing.name: Star Wars: Rebellion / Open-SWR
listing.summary: Open-SWR is an unofficial, open-source reimplementation of Star Wars: Rebellion (1998). It runs on modern systems, using the Godot engine. To play, you need your own legal copy of the original game files. Open-SWR is not affiliated with or endorsed by Lucasfilm, Disney or LucasArts.
